import hashlib,json,pathlib,resource,subprocess,time
started=time.monotonic()
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
base=root/'docs/research/100bit-spend-path-20261013/evidence'
out=base/'j1r13-artifact-20261019'
rp=base/'decision1h-rollover-measurements-20261019'
bp=base/'readonly-runtime-1h-20261019'
hp=base/'lean-module-hygiene-inventory-20261019'
pp=base/'prepared-arithmetic-proposals-20261019'
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def ref(p):return {'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size}
def write(p,j):p.write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
r=load(rp/'FINAL-RESULT.json');b=load(bp/'SUMMARY.json');h=load(hp/'SUMMARY.json');p=load(pp/'proposal-note.json');phase=load(rp/'phase-costs.json');cost=load(rp/'costed-proposals.json');pin=load(out/'artifact-pin.json')
ELF='4e1fd78fbddb39cb9599de7694105547d8e86e7451f8b9f3e9626789036e8711'
REV='32559d2696b89cdbd75304c1f7624f94dfe125ae'
LEAD='f59a21fc15dcad23fcad412afe42b83ee319ed50'
assert pin['pins'][0]['sha256']==r['fixed_ELF_sha256']==b['candidate_elf_sha256']==ELF
assert pin['source_revision']==r['verifier_producing_source']==b['source_revision']==REV
assert b['gate_pass'] is False and b['observed_case_count']==3
assert len(r['result_table'])==6 and len(r['resource_receipts'])==6

compact=[]
for x in phase['rows']:
 s=x['stage1'];v=x['settlement'];si=s['phase_intervals'];vi=v['nested_verifier_phase_intervals']
 def to(items,name):return next(z['cost'] for z in items if z['to']==name)
 def cat(items,prefix):return sum(z['cost'] for z in items if z['to'].startswith(prefix))
 assert sum(z['cost'] for z in si)+s['after_last_marker_to_verifier_return']==s['invoked_verifier']['consumed']
 assert sum(z['cost'] for z in vi)+v['after_last_marker_to_verifier_return']==v['nested_invoked_verifier']['consumed']
 assert s['transaction_cu']<1400000 and v['transaction_cu']<1400000
 compact.append({'case':x['case'],
  'stage1':{'entry_through_parsed':to(si,'parsed'),'semantic':to(si,'semantic'),'prepare':to(si,'prepare'),
   'all_Merkle_including_first_geometry':cat(si,'merkle:'),'all_query_arithmetic':cat(si,'query:'),
   'checkpoint_write':to(si,'checkpoint-write'),'account_copy_and_written_marker':to(si,'pool-adapter-stage1-checkpoint-written'),
   'after_last_marker':s['after_last_marker_to_verifier_return'],'invoked_verifier_CU':s['invoked_verifier']['consumed'],'transaction_CU':s['transaction_cu']},
  'stage2_settlement':{'entry_through_parsed':sum(z['cost'] for z in vi[:next(i for i,z in enumerate(vi) if z['to']=='parsed')+1]),
   'checkpoint_read_and_gamma_powers':to(vi,'checkpoint-read'),'all_Merkle_including_first_geometry':cat(vi,'merkle:'),
   'all_query_arithmetic':cat(vi,'query:'),'relation':to(vi,'relation'),'final':to(vi,'final'),
   'after_last_marker':v['after_last_marker_to_verifier_return'],
   'semantic_and_prepare':'Not re-executed. Authenticated resume supplies prepared state; checkpoint-read interval includes gamma powers.',
   'nested_invoked_verifier_CU':v['nested_invoked_verifier']['consumed'],
   'Pool_inclusive_invoked_CU':v['invoked_pool']['consumed'],'Pool_outside_nested_verifier_CU':v['pool_inclusive_minus_nested_verifier'],
   'transaction_CU':v['transaction_cu'],'all_program_consumption_lines':v['all_program_consumption_lines']}})

runs=[]
for x in r['resource_receipts']:
 q=load(rp/x['receipt']);cmd=load(rp/x['command'])
 assert q['exit_status']==0 and int(q['process_swaps'])==0 and q['source_revision']==REV
 runs.append({**x,'command':cmd,'receipt':ref(rp/x['receipt']),
   'features':{'executed_SBF_Cargo_features':['pool-adapter','private-leaf-salts'],'native_driver_features':['private-leaf-salts'],'native_driver_has_prover_dependency':True},
   'driver_source_identity':'Existing older native driver pinned separately; source_revision here identifies the loaded verifier ELF, not a new native rebuild.'})

recover=[]
for x in h['missing_module_recovery']:
 assert sha(root/x['canonical_repo_source'])==x['sha256']
 recover.append({k:x[k] for k in ['module','status','canonical_repo_source','sha256','minimal_canonical_fix']})
aliases=[{k:x[k] for k in ['canonical_module','staged_alias_module','canonical_repo_source','canonical_source_sha256','exact_namespace_difference_for_byte_identical_alias','minimal_canonical_fix']} for x in h['alias_pairs']]
collisions=[{k:x[k] for k in ['module','current_split_source','current_sha256','historical_unprefixed_source','historical_sha256','minimal_canonical_fix','compile_status_in_current_packet','namespace_change']} for x in h['collisions']]

source_options={
 'status':'UNAPPLIED_PROPOSALS_ONLY_NO_SOURCE_CHANGE_OR_MEASURED_OPTIMIZATION',
 'cost_basis':'Frozen-artifact phase intervals and exact source operation/dependency counts. Numerical arithmetic savings below are budget targets, not forecasts or measured speedups; no unimplemented saving is credited.',
 'query_split':cost['query_rebalance_alone'],
 'hot_spot_candidates':[
  {'candidate':'Reuse the gamma power array computed in prepared_claim for tx1 queries',
   'source':'verifier.rs::prepared_claim; tx1; weights.rs::powers',
   'work_count':'Two source calls to powers<29>(gamma) in stage1; at most one source call can be removed. Its 29th multiplication may already be dead-code eliminated.',
   'estimated_savings':'UNMEASURED. No defensible CU quote narrower than the enclosing ~156k Prepare interval. The separate note gives a 15.6–31.2k budget scenario explicitly not a forecast.',
   'decision_needed':'Approve a frame-safe concrete API/ownership proposal, not a by-value extra928B return. Keep codec, ordered583 and failure/observer gates identical; re-extract affected declarations and batch strict SBF stack/CU gates.'},
  {'candidate':'Private prepared canonical operands for EbyKDot and repeated query dot decoding',
   'source':'fast_pairing.rs::EbyKDot::push; fast_dots.rs::four_dots; verifier.rs::prepared_claim and View::parse; weights.rs::pair',
   'mechanics':'Inspect redundant canonical conversions/checks for already validated private operands and precompute coefficient limb views. Keep public/untrusted entry checks and first-failure behavior; a private validated carrier must justify every avoided recheck. Existing optimized paths are the baseline, not new savings.',
   'estimated_savings':'UNMEASURED; use the measured semantic/prepare/query/relation intervals only as ceilings. Do not assign a CU reduction before a focused approved comparison.',
   'decision_needed':'Approve a concrete arithmetic/validation-preserving patch and its equivalence obligations. Require codec1233 and ordered583 identity, checkpoint/injection regressions, extraction/re-pin and batched SBF stack/CU check.'},
  {'candidate':'Reuse query geometry values already calculated, and remove unused denominator-vector payload copies',
   'source':'verifier.rs::QueryGeometry::for_range and accumulate',
   'mechanics':'for_range computes line_x and line_z later reconstructed in accumulate; denominators payload is only subsequently used for its length. Propose a private transient geometry carrier/count preserving query, field and Digest32 order.',
   'estimated_savings':'UNMEASURED. First-Merkle geometry is not separately marked, so the current artifact cannot price this component. No savings credited.',
   'decision_needed':'New source proposal/equivalence and layout/stack review, same codec/trace gates and batched SBF audit/CU; no new attribute assumed authorized.'},
  {'candidate':'Arithmetic hot-spot reduction in semantic terminal work and stage2 Weights relation',
   'source':'r1_semantic.rs::verify_finish; terminal_qm31; weights.rs::Weights::pair and private field kernels',
   'mechanics':'Prioritize exact sparse/factored expressions, shared canonical field operands and reduced normalization only when proved equal to current QM31/WideExact arithmetic. Do not skip any relation, row, Merkle path, hash or sampler call.',
   'estimated_savings':cost['costed_work_priorities'][:2],
   'budget_scenario':cost['budget_target_combination_unmeasured'],
   'decision_needed':'Authorize focused hotspot investigation/patch proposals. Current detail-phases is off; coarse intervals do not establish finer attribution or achievable speedup. Every implementation needs exact codec/ordered-trace equivalence, affected proof re-pin, checkpoint/injection gates and strict SBF/CU validation.'}],
 'prepared_or_semantic_work_relocation':{
   'dependency_and_version_note':ref(pp/'proposal-note.json'),
   'prepared_claim':'p.claim is only consumed by finish_relation in stage2. All pure claim inputs are in the bound proof plus gamma/kappa in the authenticated checkpoint; 174 EbyKDot pushes,6 finishes,29 gamma/7 kappa source powers and7 wide multiply/add terms can be relocated without changing Fiat–Shamir bytes.',
   'format_and_failure_changes':'Must explicitly version the deferred-claim checkpoint meaning/slot (or remove32bytes), preserve genuine stage1/checkpoint custody, and prove pending checks before settlement. Parse/claim failures change transaction/error order. It is not an authorized extraction-only helper move.',
   'same_fixture_worst_case_scenarios':[{'assumed_claim_CU':C,'stage1':1339527-C,'settlement_expression':str(1380079+C)+' - G + P','status':'UNMEASURED_PARAMETER_SCENARIO'} for C in [25000,50000,100000]],
   'equation':'Total becomes 2719606 - G + P: only duplicate-gamma removal G saves work; additional decoding/version overhead P adds work. Pure relocation cannot meet the combined budget.',
   'semantic':'Deferring round/terminal arithmetic while drawing the same transcript is possible only with new pending-check semantics. Original15 QM31 challenges (240B) are absent from today’s checkpoint, or re-derivation adds46 Digest32 calls plus15 samples and breaks ordered583 identity. Requires a separate protocol/checkpoint/proof decision.',
   'existing_k11':'The current ELF also admits[3,11], moving a query in the opposite direction. It may rebalance after net savings, but worsens current stage1. No k11 run is claimed.'},
 'recommended_order':'Repair the native harness setup under its own decision; then target real arithmetic savings in both transactions before changing the query split or deferring checks. Worst measured combined shortfall119606CU cannot be removed by redistribution alone.'}
write(out/'costed-source-options.json',source_options)

report={
 'status':'MEASUREMENTS_RECORDED_J1R13_READONLY_GATE_FAILED_G_R1_1_NOT_MET',
 'lead_base':LEAD,'verifier_producing_source_revision':REV,'SBF_ELF_sha256':ELF,
 'branch':'codex/r1-checkpoint-recut-20261018',
 'artifact_pin':ref(out/'artifact-pin.json'),
 'no_source_change':True,'new_SBF_builds':0,'new_native_builds':0,'new_Lean_results':0,
 'readonly_metadata_runtime':{
  'status':'FAILED_DURING_LITESVM_EXECUTABLE_ACCOUNT_SETUP_NOT_A_COMPLETE_GATE',
  'actual_planned_vector_counts':b['planned_actual_vector_counts'],'observed_cases':b['passed_cases'],
  'completed_negative_mutations':2,'completed_honest_controls':1,
  'setup_failure':b['failure'],'blocked_case':b['failed_setup_case'],
  'unreached':b['unreached'],'unreached_case_count':12,
  'wording_discrepancy':b['wording_discrepancy'],
  'process_command_revision_features_metrics':b['process_metrics'],'driver_features':b['driver_features'],
  'signature_verification':False,'custody_claim':False,
  'projection_premise_status':'R16ReadonlyMetadataProjection runtime backing remains open. A loader setup rejection before verifier entry is not a negative test pass.',
  'unapplied_repair':ref(bp/'proposal-only.json'),
  'repair_scope':'Driver-only proposal uses LiteSVM persistence-internal/set_account_no_checks for executable metadata. It injects a synthetic loader-invalid account state and must remain explicitly separate from legal-state reachability/custody. No patch applied or rebuilt under the no-source-change instruction.',
  'evidence':ref(bp/'SUMMARY.json'),'manifest':ref(bp/'MANIFEST.json')},
 'rollover_and_same_page_controls':{
  'status':'ALL_SIX_RUNS_PASS_STAGE1_AND_ACTUAL_POOL_SETTLEMENT_AT_1400000',
  'table':r['result_table'],'runs':runs,
  'unpublished_255_over_budget_claim':'Refuted on this pinned artifact and these saved fixtures: transfer255settlement1366325,withdrawal2551380079. Not a universal bound for arbitrary inputs.',
  'transaction_vs_invoked_CU':'Pool driver has56CU outside its invoked program. Prior standalone replay had506CU outside the same verifier. Transfer13 invoked1340926 and withdrawal13 invoked1339433 match prior1h; parent transaction differences are not verifier savings.',
  'fixtures':ref(rp/'fixture-identity.json'),'driver_provenance':ref(rp/'existing-driver-provenance.json'),
  'existing_driver_disclosure':r['existing_native_driver'],
  'token_CPI_scope':'Withdrawal raw logs record Tokenkeg CPI105CU and exact token afterstate checks. Existing driver identifies LiteSVM legacy SPL Token builtin; no deployment or universal Token/Pool CU claim.',
  'key_retention':ref(rp/'key-retention.json'),'evidence':ref(rp/'FINAL-RESULT.json'),'manifest':ref(rp/'SHA256SUMS')},
 'phase_profile':{
  'status':'EXACT_EXISTING_MARK_INTERVALS_WITH_COARSE_BOUNDARIES',
  'summary':compact,'every_Merkle_and_query_interval_0_to_21':ref(rp/'phase-costs.json'),
  'interpretation':phase['interpretation'],
  'pure_parse_or_subcomponent_costs':'Cannot isolate pure parse, individual semantic substeps, prepared_claim or Pool pre/post work on this unchanged non-detail ELF; report the actual inclusive marked intervals rather than invented costs.'},
 'G_R1_1_budget':{
  'status':'NOT_MET_ALL_SIX_CURRENT_STAGE1_AND_SETTLEMENT_TRANSACTIONS_EXCEED_1300000',
  'worst_measured_combined_bound':r['required_savings_for_two_1300000_caps'],
  'query_shift_exact_measurement':'Not executable on frozen ELF: stage1 admission is only[3,10]or[3,11], and existing driver hardcodes10. Source remains unchanged. No executed9/13 result.',
  'query_shift_estimates':cost['query_rebalance_alone'],'source_admission_evidence':ref(rp/'split-measurement-limit.json'),
  'costed_proposals':ref(out/'costed-source-options.json'),
  'proposal_evidence':[ref(rp/'costed-proposals.json'),ref(pp/'proposal-note.json')],
  'estimated_vs_measured':'Only current phase costs and the measured query9 interval are observations. Rebalance projections include an explicit800CU geometry assumption; arithmetic savings are unmeasured budget targets/scenarios. No optimized source or target improvement is claimed.'},
 'Lean_module_hygiene':{
  'status':'READ_ONLY_INVENTORY_NO_LEAN_SOURCE_EDITS_OR_COMPILATION',
  'missing_sources_recovered':recover,'alias_pairs':aliases,'name_collisions':collisions,
  'every_importer_in_scanned_roots':ref(hp/'module-importers.json'),'all_source_locations_and_diffs':ref(hp/'SUMMARY.json'),
  'source_ref_tips':ref(hp/'ref-tip-inventory.json'),'historical_path_history':ref(hp/'git-history-paths.json'),
  'counts':h['counts'],'minimal_fix_sequence':h['minimal_sequence'],'scope_limits':h['scope_limits'],
  'run_receipt':ref(hp/'receipt.json'),'postcheck':ref(hp/'read-only-check.json'),
  'formal_result':'None new; #print axioms is not applicable to source/import inventory. Existing compiled/inverse-source statuses remain separately identified.'},
 'next_lead_decisions':[
  'Native readonly harness loader-setup repair and intended mutation counts; same1h ELF can remain pinned. Current suite failed and stage2 metadata cases did not execute.',
  'Concrete arithmetic hotspot proposal/measurement work: budget119606 combined savings in worst saved case before rebalance can meet two1.3M caps.',
  'If still wanted, explicit[3,9] admission plus native-driver split selection; estimated rollover settlement would exceed1.4M without other savings.',
  'Any claim/semantic deferral needs new checkpoint semantics, custody/ownership and error-order proof decisions, plus runtime and SBF gates.',
  'Route canonical Lean source-map/shim/split-owner fixes to live proof-session owners; no such fix was applied here.'],
 'preservation':{'live_worktree_and_modules_touched':False,'spend_path_Lean_source_edited':False,'ELF_or_private_keys_committed':False,'source_changes':0,'stash_used':False,
   'keys':'All new and previous keys retained securely; no key cleanup, burn, refund or authority transfer performed.',
   'resource_scope':'Native runs6GiBhigh/8GiBmax/swap0, optimized existing drivers, aggregate reservations governed. No newSBF/nativecompile/Lean job.',
   'output_policy':'New files are evidence JSON/log/SHA only. Unapplied source patches and analysis scripts are embedded as evidence text.'}}
assert all(x['stage1_transaction_cu']>1300000 and x['Pool_settlement_transaction_cu']>1300000 for x in r['result_table'])
write(out/'checkpoint-report.json',report)
usage=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
write(out/'report-assembly-receipt.json',{'target':'Read-only integrated report aggregation and phase/source equality checks','command':['python3','/tmp/r1-j1r13-report.py'],
 'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'source_revision':REV,'features':'N/A: JSON analysis only',
 'exit_status':0,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'peak_rss_bytes':usage.ru_maxrss,'swaps':usage.ru_nswap,
 'platform':'macOS, ru_maxrss bytes','print_axioms':'N/A: no Lean result','script_sha256':sha(pathlib.Path(__file__)),'script_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()})
write(out/'SHA256.json',{x.name:sha(x) for x in out.glob('*.json') if x.name!='SHA256.json'})
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'report':str((out/'checkpoint-report.json').relative_to(root)),
 'run_count':len(runs),'phase_rows':len(compact),'worst_budget':report['G_R1_1_budget']['worst_measured_combined_bound'],
 'missing_sources_recovered':len(recover),'aliases':len(aliases),'collisions':len(collisions)}))
